shape: 3-leg FULL JOIN (wd / d / ad), each leg an aggregating subquery over Sales_Ledger__dlm

scopes.note: co appears once per leg; alias reused across wd/d/ad. Resolver must scope co to its owning leg, not collapse the three.

scopeNotes: co and sap are declared once per leg (wd, d, ad). This fixture only pins the wd-leg copies by parent; the invariant test enforces that EVERY co/sap scope has a leg parent, never __root__. This is the multi-leg alias-reuse trap.

externalId.comment: No *ExternalId* output column. Grain is CommonOwnerCRMAccountId__c + CRMAccountId__c + TxMonth__c + MaterialId__c.

regressionAnchors.why: anti-join in the wd leg: LEFT JOIN Region_Assignment__dlm then WHERE Region_Assignment__dlm.Common_Owner__c IS NULL. Drop is at the wd-scope WHERE.

findings.hardcodedIdComment: '012000000000001AAA' Business Account RecordTypeId__c literal, repeated across legs
